title: Solar eclipse vs Lunar eclipse
caption:
solar eclipse vs lunar eclipse: what's the difference? 🌙
Solar eclipses come at a new moon. Lunar ones at a full moon.

explainB: A *lunar eclipse* is the earth's shadow
diff: Solar eclipses come at a *new moon.*
